explanation: Records include primary content, alternate navigational topic projections, metadata-only editions, historical witnesses, unpublished drafts, evidence attachments, geographic associations, provider rows and source registries. The number is NOT a count of unique published app modules, doctrines, articles, Mass sites, prayers or screens.
publication_guardrails: Do not turn metadata witnesses or draft prose into approved public texts.
A canonical content record may have multiple indexes, pathways, variants and source records without constituting additional content.
Do not publish source-uncertified APOL or Church Crisis dossiers.
Do not treat canonical venue provider rows as globally unique verified Mass sites.
Do not import relic publications again when place/shrine/relic IDs already exist in the app seeds.
Traditional Rosary mysteries are fifteen; luminous mysteries are an optional later addition, not an original part of the traditional cycle.
Do not claim one of four disabled Bible text editions is installed simply because its catalogue entry exists.
Do not rewrite Mass, Calendar or Pray runtime from the inventory.
